questions.q: Why is the European Union (EU) often studied as a relevant economic grouping in West African commerce?
options: All West African countries are associate political members of the EU.
The EU is a major trading partner with Africa and provides a prime model for regional economic integration.
The EU dictates the internal monetary policies of the Central Bank of Nigeria.
The EU shares a direct land border with several ECOWAS nations.
questions.explain: The **European Union (EU)** is highly relevant to West African commerce because it is a massive trading bloc that engages with African nations (e.g., through ACP-EU partnership agreements) and serves as the most advanced global example of successful regional economic integration.
